claude-bridge/claude-fable-5.character: The advisor's own session model and the default planner. The advisor session runs at medium; planner nodes run at high. Shares the Anthropic session allowance — do not assign checking, review, reduction, browser verification, or implementation. When Anthropic capacity is reached, planning falls back to Grok at high and the advisor session switches to Grok. Do not fall back to Sol; this profile must not spend remaining Codex weekly on Sol.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-luna.character: Extremely cheap Codex leftover: keep using it for short-leash procedural work even when the Codex weekly is nearly gone. Scouting, mechanical chores, routine mid-phase checks, repair verification, test-harness findings, and browser verification — deterministic anchors backstop it. 272K window. Do not assign adversarial-tier checking or substantial implementation. Always runs on max.

claude-bridge/claude-opus-5.character: Reserve for genuinely new or greenfield UX/frontend implementation only when the Anthropic 5-hour window is fresh, always with frontend-design loaded. Runs at medium. Grok is the default UX implementation model in this profile; do not spend another Opus attempt after a capacity limit. Not for existing-UX tweaks, checking, review, reduction, planning, or backend.

claude-bridge/claude-sonnet-5.character: The adversarial-tier reviewer at high: schema, auth, security, money, and data-boundary checks, final whole-diff review before PR, rechecks after an overturned pass, and reduction. Spends the Anthropic 5-hour window on bounded review bursts, not long builds. 1M window — still split oversized whole-branch reviews per package or phase. Not for planning, greenfield UX, or substantial feature implementation. Grok is the review fallback when the Anthropic window is exhausted; a Grok review of a Grok build needs a second anchor-backed check.

cursor/grok-4.6.character: The implementation workhorse in this profile: long or difficult backend, data, and service work, mixed-stack, substantial existing-UX changes, research, and UX implementation when Opus is unavailable. Always load frontend-design for UX work. Also the planning/advisor fallback when Fable is at Anthropic capacity, and the review fallback when Sonnet is unavailable. 200K window — keep packets bounded. The only Cursor model this map may use. Preserve Cursor catalog fast-mode default.

scout.description: Read-only investigation with bounded, source-linked findings.

planner.description: Plan fixed work from verified code and product constraints.

reducer.description: Reduce independent worker artifacts into bounded decisions and conflicts.

builder.description: Implement fixed acceptance criteria in one assigned worktree.

checker.description: Fresh-context review of the completed work, with a bounded inline-repair mandate for small findings. Adversarial tier runs on Sonnet; procedural tier runs on Luna; Grok is the review fallback when Anthropic capacity is exhausted.

browser-verifier.description: Integrated browser verification and safe evidence capture. Defaults to luna; use Grok only for a genuinely ambiguous visual or behavioral judgment.
